name: id
description: Stable, unique identifier that survives renaming or relocation. Use an auto-generation tool to create in format {UUID}.

name: function
description: Primary function of the artifact. Allowed values depend on its Note Type/profile.

name: topics
description: Subjects the artifact is principally about. Use one or more concise, reusable terms; prefer lowercase kebab-case, such as metadata, color-theory, or content-modeling.

name: updated
description: App-generated date and time of the most recent modification. Format: ISO 8601 timestamp: {YYYY-MM-DD} or {YYYY-MM-DD}T{HH:MM}

name: references
description: Resources someone can consult for additional information, evidence, or context.

name: attribution
description: Who or what should receive credit.

name: created
description: App-generated creation date and time. Format: ISO 8601 timestamp: {YYYY-MM-DD} or {YYYY-MM-DD}T{HH:MM}
